name: early growth response 2
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: EGR2 encodes E3 SUMO-protein ligase EGR2. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease (semidominant); Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 4E (autosomal recessive). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia/Small Lymphocytic Lymphoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Semidominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from G2P. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Ambry Genetics. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
